import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth'],
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()
from django.db import models, connection

class Tag(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    slug = models.SlugField()
    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'
        unique_together = (('title', 'slug'),)
        index_together = (('title', 'slug'),)

with connection.schema_editor() as editor:
    editor.create_model(Tag)
print('created; constraints:', {n: (c['columns'], c['unique'], c['index']) for n, c in connection.introspection.get_constraints(connection.cursor(), Tag._meta.db_table).items() if c['columns'] == ['title', 'slug']})
# Now remove index_together (the reported crash)
with connection.schema_editor() as editor:
    editor.alter_index_together(Tag, Tag._meta.index_together, [])
print('index_together removed OK')
EOF
